# Synthetic assignment fixtures

These hand-written HTML files use course-module, activity-date and
submission-summary shapes described in the repository's
[Moodle source research](../../../../docs/research/2026-11-15-moodle-academic-data-sources.md).
All names, IDs, dates, text and URLs in the fixture bodies are synthetic. The
English labels and machine-readable dates exercise the supported parser shapes.
They do not establish Quanta's installed markup, permissions, locale or polling
effects.

The team fixture compares an already applied source-effective date with a
separate extension. Pulse never selects a group override from candidate dates.
The individual fixture supplies an earlier effective day than the base date
and exercises the optional cut-off and grading fields. The missing-fields
fixture keeps an explicitly unset date, an ambiguous localized date and
released feedback separate from an unknown submission.
